desc: Reduce the problem to finding the largest root m <= isqrt(A) with exactly two distinct prime factors, then output m^2.

Implement the full Python solution: sieve distinct prime-factor counts up to 1,000,000, build prefix array best[i] = largest j <= i with exactly two distinct prime factors, read all queries, compute m = isqrt(A), and output best[m] * best[m] using sys.stdin.buffer and sys.stdout.write.
Verify sample and edge cases (A=36, A=404, A=60, A=10^12, A=123456789) and confirm performance for Q=200,000.
